// =============================================================================
// Entry point — CSS Cascade Layers ordering.
//
// Load order:
//   1. Font @imports (MUST be at stylesheet root — CSS spec forbids @import
//      nested inside @layer blocks; violation silently drops the rules and
//      breaks web fonts like Clash Display / --fm-en).
//   2. @layer declaration — fixes priority independent of source order.
//   3. Layer blocks populated via meta.load-css so each partial stays
//      independently editable and source maps resolve to the original file.
//
// Layer priority (low → high):
//   reset < base < layout < components < pages < utilities < state
//
// Rationale:
//   - `pages` sits above `components` so page-specific overrides win without
//     specificity games.
//   - `utilities` above `pages` so `.f-display-0`, `.--regular`, `.--fm-en`
//     etc. always trump page/component rules — mirrors the old @use source
//     order where base/ loaded before components/ and utils were always last.
//   - `_root.scss` (CSS custom properties + typography/color/container utility
//     classes) lives in `utilities` so .f-*/.clr-* classes win over components
//     and pages. :root{} custom properties work correctly in any layer.
//   - `state` is the highest — TS-driven `data-reveal`, `data-mask`, `is-*`
//     dynamic state always wins, without !important.
// =============================================================================

@use "sass:meta";

// --- Fonts first (root-level @import) ---
@include meta.load-css("base/fonts");

@layer reset, base, layout, components, pages, utilities, state;

@layer reset {
  @include meta.load-css("base/reset");
}

@layer base {
  @include meta.load-css("base/init");
}

@layer layout {
  @include meta.load-css("layouts/header");
  @include meta.load-css("layouts/drawer");
  @include meta.load-css("layouts/footer");
}

@layer components {
  @include meta.load-css("components/backdrop");
  @include meta.load-css("components/masking-text");
  @include meta.load-css("components/corner-bracket");
  @include meta.load-css("components/button");

}

content.content:
# SCSS Rules

- BEM pattern for class naming
- Source: `resource/scss/` → output: `resource/dist/`
- Do NOT run build commands — dev server reflects changes on save automatically
- Admin CSS (`admin/resource/css/`) is separate — do not import from public SCSS entry

## Token Contract

- Reusable tokens → `resource/scss/abstract/` or `base/_root.scss`
- Use `var(--clr-*)`, `var(--duration-*)` etc. in consumers — no raw hex when a semantic token exists upstream
- Prefer semantic tokens over raw values when an upstream token exists
- **Do NOT use CSS variable fallbacks** like `var(--token, fallback)`. Use `var(--token)` or `fluid(...)` directly.
- Do not introduce base/root tokens for one-off component values — only when genuinely shared across multiple features

## Fluid Helper

- In **component, layout, page** SCSS: call `fluid(min, max)` directly
- In shared **`abstract/`** or **`base/`**: use `#{fluid(...)}` interpolation only when emitting CSS custom properties or shared tokens
- Files outside `resource/scss/abstract/` and `resource/scss/base/`: add `@use "../abstract" as *;` at top before using `fluid(...)` and other shared helpers

## Reset / Init Contract

`_init.scss`가 다음을 전역 적용함 — 컴포넌트/페이지 SCSS에서 단독 중복 선언 금지:
- `margin: 0` → `*` selector로 이미 0
- `padding: 0` → `*` selector로 이미 0
- `list-style: none` → `ul, ol, li`에 이미 없음
- `padding-left: 0` / `padding-right: 0` 등 단일 축 0도 동일하게 금지
  (단, 직상위 규칙에서 해당 축에 non-zero 값이 선언되어 있으면 예외)

`@include font("...")` mixin은 `font-size`, `line-height`, `letter-spacing`을 모두 출력함.
mixin 호출 직후 동일 값으로 개별 재선언하지 않는다.

# Frontend Rules

- Bundler: Vite / Language: TypeScript (ES6+)
- 3D: Three.js. Main scenes use `core/Engine.ts`; works scatter is the standalone secondary renderer in `pages/works/render/WorksSceneManager.ts`.
- **Do NOT run `npm run build`, `npm run watch`, or `npm install`**
  - Reason: Vite dev server at `http://localhost:8888` auto-bundles on every file save
  - Only `npm install <package>` is allowed when adding a new dependency
  - Do not include these commands in verification steps, PR notes, or agent plans

## TypeScript

- All shared types/interfaces/enums live in `resource/ts/types/*.types.ts`; avoid inline exported types and `any`.
- Shared constants, colors, sizes, URLs, selectors, and timings live in `resource/ts/config/*.config.ts` or page scene config files.
- Page theatre: `resource/ts/pages/<page>/theatre/`
- Page scene/config composition: `resource/ts/pages/<page>/scene/`
- Page-only lifecycle/runtime: `resource/ts/pages/<page>/runtime/`
- Standalone page renderer exception: `resource/ts/pages/<page>/render/` (currently works scatter)
- Shared engine/runtime code stays out of page folders.

## Three.js

- `dispose()` required for every geometry, material, texture, render target, and standalone renderer.
- Main WebGL renderer ownership belongs to `Engine`; standalone secondary renderers must call `renderer.dispose()` and `renderer.forceContextLoss()`.
- No object creation inside render loops or RAF hot paths.
- `addEventListener` must have matching `removeEventListener`.
- No monkey-patching Three.js API.
